svg.title: Spreader plate drawing, 1:1, seen from the case side (the inner face)

g.text: SPREADER PLATE, a standard flat aluminium bar, nothing cut from it but
its holes, seen from the case side (the inner face, looking toward the
wall, the case's far end behind the viewer), 1:1, millimetres. 20 mm
wide (its height installed) x 5 mm thick, cut to 85 mm long. Its lower
edge rests on the tray's end-wall ledge, z 6.0 above the board face;
its upper edge stands at z 26.0. The case holds at any height from
16.8 to 27.5 mm; the standard widths between are 20 and 25 mm. The
stock's width tolerance is an assumption, to be read from the
supplier's standard when the bar is sourced.
case outline 64.52 x 29.15
bolt zone 10.0
bolt zone 10.0
T921 tab screw u 12.60 z 16.50
T911 tab screw u 37.20 z 16.50
Red bar: the tab hole height range 15.30 to 17.30 above the board face
(nominal 16.50). The tab holes stand 9.30 to 11.30 mm (nominal 10.50)
above the bar's lower edge, the distance to mark and drill from the lower
edge: M3 holes (tapping drill 2.5) drilled and tapped through the whole
bar from this face; the screws are M3 x 5.
The range is unconfirmed: the owner measures the delivered board before
marking the bar.
Two M3 countersunk holes, one for each pilaster's insert, countersunk on
the back face (the wall face, away from the viewer; countersink 6.3
across, for the 5.5 mm head shown by the inner circle), take the tray
screws at z 11.65 above the board face (5.65 above the lower edge), the
two 6.8 mm or more apart. Set each M3 heat-set insert flush and square in
its pilaster's end face before the bar is fitted: a proud insert holds the
tray off the bar. The bar's two tray-screw holes are marked from the
printed tray with the bar seated on its ledge, then drilled and
countersunk until each head sits flush with or below the back face; the
back face lies on the machine wall. The two M3 tapped-through holes enter
the inner face drawn here.
Wall bolts M4, one at the plate's mid-height (z 16.00) at each end, washer
dia 9.0, standing in the 10.0 mm end zones outside the case.
Length arithmetic: case outer width at the plate 64.52 + 2 x bolt zone
10.0 = 84.52, not more than the plate length 85.0 (margin 0.48).
Wall opening = the plate and the tray's end wall together + 1.5 per side:
88.0 x 35.6, within the unit's opening in the plastic wall (z -10.0 to
Interface material between the triac faces and the plate, and between the
plate and the wall, is not in the catalogue and is stated in the case
record.
